_mode_options.new: Start a completely new simulation. Will delete old result folder and h5 file.
_mode_options.continue: Resume from the last saved step in the h5 file (default).
_mode_options.restart: Reset to step 0 but keep the same h5 filename (overwrite existing data).

notes: This is the default configuration for continuing simulation. Change mode to 'new' when you want to start over.
